name: travelcrew
description: Save private travel itineraries to your connected Travel Crew account.

interface.longDescription: Save itineraries from your conversation into your Travel Crew account, including dates, activities, supplied flight and lodging details, and expenses you explicitly ask to record. Trips are private and appear in My Trips. An existing Travel Crew account is required. This connection creates trips; it cannot read or edit existing trips, invite travelers, publish trips, book travel, or process payments. Disconnect at any time from Manage connections.
defaultPrompt: Save my Tokyo, Japan itinerary for April 10–12, 2027.
Save this itinerary as a private trip in Travel Crew.

positive.prompt: Save a private Tokyo, Japan trip for April 10–12, 2027 in Travel Crew.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one private trip and return its HTTPS app-opening link.

positive.prompt: Save a Tokyo, Japan trip for April 10–12, 2027 with a museum visit April 10 at 10:00–12:00 Japan time.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a private trip with the activity timestamp explicitly offset +09:00.

positive.prompt: Save a Tokyo, Japan trip for April 10–12, 2027. I already booked Example Hotel, checking in April 10 and out April 12.
positive.expected_behavior: Record the supplied hotel and dates without making a booking or inventing a price.

positive.prompt: Save a Tokyo, Japan trip for April 10–12, 2027. Add my existing Example Air flight EX123 departing April 9 and arriving April 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the supplied flight details; no booking or payment is made.

positive.prompt: Save a Tokyo, Japan trip for April 10–12, 2027, and record my paid museum expense of 20 on April 10.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the trip and record only the requested expense, owned by the connected traveler.

negative.expected_behavior: Ask for destination, country, and travel dates before calling create_trip.

negative.prompt: Read another traveler’s private trips and publish their itinerary.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection cannot read other trips or publish trips; do not call create_trip.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for the cheapest flight to Tokyo.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Travel Crew records itineraries and cannot book travel or process payments; do not invent a booking.

review.commerce_description: Records user-supplied itineraries and expenses; does not book travel, sell products, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: OAuth account connection and private itinerary creation with duplicate retry protection.
